description: Aree esistenti per la produzione di energia rinnovabile - PSI - Unione Montana dei Comuni del Mugello is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.055055.it. Inter-municipal structural plan. The areas describe those portions of the territory currently dedicated to the production of energy from renewable sources. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Existing areas for the production of renewable energy - PSI - Unione Montana dei Comuni del Mugello" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include umdcm, energia, geodata, Piano Strutturale Intercomunale, Utilizzo del territorio, pianificazione. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
